strategic_ideas.core_idea: In the , key priorities are controlling central squares, developing minor pieces rapidly, and ensuring king safety before launching attacks.
strategic_ideas.typical_mistakes: Moving the same piece multiple times in the opening, neglecting king castling, and initiating premature pawn attacks without solid central support.
strategic_ideas.key_plans: Fight for the center (e4/d4/e5/d5), complete minor piece development (Knights and Bishops), and castle early.
